ModMetaData.name: Red Rising
ModMetaData.author: cinergy92
ModMetaData.description:
A total conversion built around an engineered caste hierarchy: ten Colors, each a xenotype with its own capabilities and its own costs, bound together by a social order that gives the hierarchy real mechanical weight.
Requires Biotech for the Color system and Ideology for the caste hierarchy.
This mod is a work in progress.
